recipes.name: The Easiest Tuna Salad (3 Ingredients)
ingredients: Creamy dill salad dressing, to taste
1-2 small dill pickles, finely chopped (gherkins recommended)
instructions: Place your tuna into a medium mixing bowl. Using a fork, finely shred the tuna as finely as possible.
Add in your pickles and dressing and mix together until combined.
Season to taste with salt and enjoy.
